{{Short description|German chemist (1926–2012)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2021}}
'''Heinz A. Staab''' (26 March 1926 – 29 July 2012) was a German [[chemist]]. From 1990 to 1996 he was Präsident der [[Max Planck Society]].

==Biography==
Staab was born in 1926 in [[Darmstadt]]. He studied chemistry at the [[University of Marburg|Marburg]], the [[University of Tübingen|Tübingen]] and medicine in [[University of Heidelberg|Heidelberg]]. [[Hans Meerwein]], [[Rolf Huisgen]], [[Adolf Butenandt]] and [[Georg Wittig]] were among his academic teachers. In 1962 he was appointed professor for organic chemistry at the [[Ruprecht-Karls-Universität Heidelberg]].<ref name="chemie.de 2012">{{cite web | title=Heinz Staab | website=chemie.de | date=14 December 2012 | url=https://www.chemie.de/lexikon/Heinz_Staab.html | language=de | access-date=14 July 2021}}</ref> Staab worked in the field of heterocyclic chemistry.<ref name="chemie.de 2012" /> Staab was the president of the [[German Chemical Society]] (GDCh) from 1984 till 1985.<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.iupac.org/publications/ci/1999/november/37thcongress.html | title = Chemistry International, Vol. 21, No. 6, November 1999| access-date=13 May 2009}}</ref>  He was director of the [[Max Planck Society]] from 1984 until 1990.<ref name="Springer Science and Business Media LLC 1996 pp. ix–ix">{{cite journal | title=Heinz Staab (on his seventieth birthday) | journal=Russian Chemical Bulletin | publisher=Springer Science and Business Media LLC | volume=45 | issue=3 | year=1996 | issn=1066-5285 | doi=10.1007/bf01435769 | pages=ix| s2cid=195243063 }}</ref><ref name="Max-Planck-Gesellschaft 2021">{{cite web | title=Max-Planck-Gesellschaft trauert um Altpräsident Heinz A. Staab | website=Max-Planck-Gesellschaft | date=31 May 2021 | url=https://www.mpg.de/staab | language=de | access-date=14 July 2021}}</ref> From 1990 to 1996 he was Präsident der Max Planck Society.<ref name="Max-Planck-Gesellschaft 2021_2" />

Staab died on 29 July 2012 at the age of 86 in Berlin.<ref name="Max-Planck-Gesellschaft 2021_2">{{cite web | title=Heinz A. Staab (1984–1990) | website=Max-Planck-Gesellschaft | date=31 May 2021 | url=https://www.mpg.de/8235381/heinz-staab | language=de | access-date=14 July 2021}}</ref>

==Awards==
In 1979 Staab received the {{ill|Adolf von Baeyer Prize|de|Adolf-von-Baeyer-Denkmünze}} from the German Chemical Society.<ref name="chemie.de 2012" /> He has been awarded honorary professorship by the [[Indian Institute of Science]] and [[Academia Sinica]].<ref name="chemie.de 2012" /> In 1996 he was awarded the [[Harnack Medal]].<ref name="chemie.de 2012" />
